pending_commit.commit_message: hammerd: add dbus_wrapper for sending DBus signal. During the updating, user should not unplug the base. In this CL, hammerd emits the DBus signal to notify other processes of the update status. When the RW section needs to be updated, hammerd emits "update started" signal. Then hammerd should emit "update succeeded" or "update failed" signal at the end of the update process. hammerd: split needsupdate into two functions Split NeedsUpdate function into two separate functions: - UpdatePossible: the current values of key_version and rollback would allow flashing the given section - VersionMismatch: the version of the given section is different from that of the local firmware file This makes updating logic more explicit for hammer_updater to control (e.g. if we want to force update even though the version is the same, based on a command-line flag), and allows hammerd to be smarter about catching certain edge cases (e.g. not bothering to recover a RW section, if the key_version of the local firmware file doesn't match). BUG=b:64193939,b:64193897 TEST=cros_workon_make --board=poppy hammerd --test TEST=Under the situation RO (key1, v1) RW (key1, v1), invoke hammerd with (key2, v2). Should print: "RW section needs update, but local image is incompatible. Continuing to post-RW process; maybe RO can be updated." (RO update logic is not yet implemented.) TEST=Under the situation RO (key1, v1) RW (corrupt), invoke hammerd with (key2, v2). Should print: "RW section is unusable, but local image is incompatible. Giving up." CHROMIUM: ipu3-imgu: Separate internal power sequence from rpm imgu HW requires power cycle before restarting stream. But with synced rpm put call, the whole ACPI power domain will be turned off which adds uncessary latency. This patch separates the internal power sequence of imgu from the rpm callbacks so that ACPI power domain is not toggled frequently.
